assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered
The monitoring is to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes
The monitoring is to evaluate changes contributing to symptomatic episodes
This precertification is required to obtain prior approval for the diagnostic procedure
The payer denied the claim under Reason Code CO-197
